version: Illustrative V1, exploratory follow-up after viewing the initial study
notes: The 3000 input is assumed to be accumulated net trading profits, not total account equity or buying power.
The numerical example assumes sufficient unborrowed cash and one active stock idea; concurrent ideas must share the budget.
Freeze the profit pool and loss budget when opening the idea. Recalculate for the next idea; never reset after partial exits or re-entry.
An exit trigger and buffer cannot guarantee an absolute loss ceiling through gaps, halts, or execution failures.
Fixed policy comparisons are exploratory. The earlier evaluation data have already been inspected and are not a fresh holdout.
The price-only entry cohort is not the app's morning selection model. No policy is represented as a validated ideal strategy.
holding_intent: Exit on the first profit, risk, overnight-eligibility or time condition; two weeks is only the outer limit.
overnight_review: Completed minute close near 15:55 ET (15:50–15:58 if needed), with a same-session next-open execution available within two minutes.
overnight_gate: Marked whole-idea loss must be no worse than the smaller of $600 and 3% of total dollars purchased.
